summary.text: Art Haywood is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania State Senate, representing District 4 since December 1, 2014, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, against Republican Todd Johnson. He is a lawyer.

paragraphs.text: Art Haywood earned a high school diploma from Rogers High School, a bachelor's degree from Morehouse College in 1979, a graduate degree from the London School of Economics in 1981 and a law degree from the University of Michigan in 1985.
His career experience includes working as a lawyer.
Haywood advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.

For 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the Health and Human Services, Appropriations, Finance, Institutional Sustainability and Innovation, and Judiciary committees; he chaired the Health and Human Services Committee in 2023 and 2024.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Haywood said the main message of his campaign is "dignity for all."
He listed raising pay and health care for all among the policy areas he is passionate about, and named Planned Parenthood, the Working Families Party and Mayor Parker among his endorsers.
